name: Ijou Seiai -Mousou Bitch to Shinsei Bitch-
original_name: 異常性愛-妄想ビッチと真正ビッチ-
source:
A clever girl with a man-seducing body and glasses Rema Sasaki secretly holds a lustful wish in her heart... 
When she meets her old friend, [Real Slut] Mia Hasegawa who sleeps around as opposed to her adorable looking,
she grows her lust even bigger... One of these days, an ideal man confessed his love to her that her imaginations would come true...

聰明、身材誘人的戴眼鏡女孩佐佐木怜茉在心中秘密藏著淫慾願望。當她遇到老朋友、外表可愛卻四處尋歡的「真正蕩婦」長谷川明杏後，她的慾望變得更加強烈……某天，一名理想男人向她告白，她的幻想即將成真……
